projects.name: Garaa
projects.description: Identity & document verification — Manual KYC and identity checks break down when documents suffer blur, glare, tampered text, or mismatched faces. Browser-native verification pipeline combining OCR, QR parsing, face landmark checks, and document quality scoring.
highlights: Built and shipped with Team Garaa — 1st Runner-up at Baloon National Hackathon 2026.

projects.name: DevHarbour
projects.description: Developer learning & building platform — Student developers often lack structured builder ecosystems that bridge early learning into shipped hackathon projects. End-to-end platform strategy and community programming serving 4,000+ users.
highlights: Co-Founder since October 2025 — product development, platform strategy, community growth, and hackathon organization.

projects.name: Zyr Resume Studio
projects.description: AI-assisted resume builder — Resumes often suffer from clunky formatting workflows and inconsistent bullet refinement. Fast frontend workspace combining live preview formatting with guided AI editing.

projects.name: Laser Distance System
projects.description: Optical ranging for security — Perimeter security prototypes require low-latency distance thresholding without bulky sensor arrays. Optical distance calculation loop coupled with threshold trigger verification.
highlights: Built the measurement workflow and explored practical security monitoring triggers.

projects.name: IoT Weather Detection
projects.description: Arduino environmental monitor — Localized environmental monitoring needs low-cost telemetry directly from physical sensor modules. Arduino sensor wiring and real-time telemetry readout code.
highlights: Built hardware connections and live monitoring firmware.
